thesis: The discussion explores the historical evolution of business leadership in the United States, moving from an era of small businesses with perfect information to the managerial hierarchies introduced by the railroad revolution. It further examines the subsequent responses from the labor movement and government, while highlighting a shift in focus toward biographical studies of executives to understand their conflicts and decision-making processes.
